items.html: For Aba and Ima, the main influence drawn to them from Arich Anpin comes through the two Mazalot of his beard, as above. And those Mazalot are drawn from the Moach Stimaa, the Hochma of Arich Anpin; for the thirteen Tikunim of the beard come out of the concealed brain, as above. But ZA hangs and holds in the holy Atika itself. Meaning: in respect of the fact that he clothes Arich Anpin from the lower half of its Tifferet and below, he holds in it literally. And in respect of the fact that the thirteen strands and the thirteen white ones of the white head, which is the secret of the Keter itself of Arich Anpin, are drawn to his head to influence it, he hangs in it — not a literal grasping, but he is suspended by the secret of those hairs and white ones.
